title: FCRL-energy: fair and sustainable allocation of energy support under price shocks
description:
Runnable, tested decision system developed from the FCRL-MARL, SC-RL and XRL-URM frameworks of AI with Integrity: Shaping Ethical, Transparent, and Equitable Urban Futures (Springer Nature, 2026), Chapter 3.

It shares a fixed energy support budget among regions before need is known, guarantees every region a minimum share of its need through adaptive conformal inference that stays valid after price shocks, shares the rest with a policy trained to protect the worst-off regions first while avoiding support above need, keeps a small emergency reserve that is paid after the month to the regions left with the lowest coverage, and explains every allocation in plain language. It is evaluated on synthetic data and on Eurostat degree-day, poverty, population and energy price data for the NUTS 2 regions of Greece, Bulgaria, Spain, Portugal and Italy, with stress tests for price rises and budget cuts.
